sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following words is an example of a collective noun?
In the story 'Papa's Spectacles', where did the family finally find his missing glasses?
options: B) Resting on his own head
questions.answer: B) Resting on his own head

questions.question_text: Choose the correct article to fill in the blank: My mother is reading ___ interesting book.
According to the poem 'The Rainbow', what builds a beautiful road from the earth to the sky?
What is the comparative degree of the adjective 'heavy'?
In 'The Wise Parrot', why was the bird highly valued by its owner?
options: A) It could sing sweet songs
B) It gave clever advice and solved problems
C) It had beautifully colored feathers
D) It could fly faster than an eagle
questions.answer: B) It gave clever advice and solved problems

questions.question_text: Identify the pronoun in the following sentence: The little dog wagged its tail happily.
What does the frog in the poem 'The Frog' love to do all day in his damp home?
options: B) Sleeping on a green lily pad
C) Croaking loudly at the sky
D) Swimming deep with the fishes
questions.answer: C) Croaking loudly at the sky

questions.question_text: Identify the tense of this sentence: 'The students will visit the museum tomorrow.'
In the story 'Gone with the Scooter', who accidentally drove away with the wrong vehicle?

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: How did the wise parrot save the merchant from losing all his hard-earned money? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The wise parrot cleverly solved the tricky riddle posed by the thief, proving the merchant's innocence and ensuring his money was safely returned to him.

questions.question_text: Rearrange these jumbled words to make a meaningful declarative sentence: 'garden / playing / the / children / are / the / in'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct meaningful sentence is: The children are playing in the garden. It starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.

questions.question_text: Based on the poem 'The Rainbow', compare the beauty of sailing ships with the clouds. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: While ships sailing on the sea and boats on rivers are pretty, the white clouds that sail across the sky are far more beautiful than them all.

questions.question_text: Identify the main verb and the helping verb in the sentence: 'The birds are flying high in the sky.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: In this sentence, the helping verb is 'are' and the main verb is 'flying'. Together, they show a continuous action happening in the present tense.

questions.question_text: Why was everyone in the house frantically searching everywhere in the story 'Papa's Spectacles'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Everyone was searching frantically because Papa could not read his morning newspaper without them, and he was getting increasingly impatient and angry with the entire family.

questions.question_text: Imagine you were present when the scooter mix-up happened in 'Gone with the Scooter'. How would you have helped resolve the confusion quickly? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would have immediately checked the license plates of the two identical scooters to spot the difference. Then, I would politely inform both owners about the honest mistake and help them exchange their keys calmly without creating a public scene.

questions.question_text: Describe a frog's life near a pond using at least two different types of pronouns and three adjectives. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: He is a small, green amphibian who loves his damp home. It spends most sunny days sitting quietly on a large lily pad. They catch tiny flies with long tongues, enjoying a peaceful and simple life by the cool pond water.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing a beautiful rainbow you saw after a heavy rain shower, mentioning its colors and shape. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: After a heavy afternoon rain, a magnificent rainbow stretched across the clear blue sky. It looked like a giant, magical bridge connecting the earth to the clouds. Its bright colors of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet glowed beautifully, making the entire landscape look incredibly peaceful and stunning.

questions.question_text: Write a short informal letter to your friend inviting them to your house to study for the upcoming English exam together. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Ravi, I hope you are doing well. Our English and Grammar exam is approaching fast next week. I invite you to come to my house this Sunday so we can study and revise all the chapters together. We can practice grammar rules and enjoy some snacks. See you soon!
